question.question: List base Vagabond characters with starting items and special action costs/results, including Ranger timing.

source_passages.quotation:
| Base character | Starting items | Special action |
|---|---|---|
| Thief | boot, torch, tea, sword | **Steal:** exhaust torch to take random hand card from player with faction pieces in your clearing |
| Tinker | boot, torch, bag, hammer | **Day Labor:** exhaust torch to take discard-pile card matching clearing; bird always qualifies |
| Ranger | boot, torch, crossbow, sword | **Hideout:** exhaust torch to repair three items, keeping their faces; immediately end Daylight and begin Evening |
To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

answer.ruling: Starting items: boot, torch, tea, sword. Steal costs exhausting a face-up, undamaged torch and takes a random hand card from a player with faction pieces in the Vagabond’s clearing.
Starting items: boot, torch, bag, hammer. Day Labor costs exhausting a face-up, undamaged torch and takes a discard-pile card matching the clearing; a bird card always qualifies.
Starting items: boot, torch, crossbow, sword. Hideout costs exhausting a face-up, undamaged torch, repairs three items while keeping their faces, immediately ends Daylight, and begins Evening.
